answer: Bonded vouching: a newcomer joins only when two established agents each lock 10 POA behind it, and each voucher may back at most two newcomers a month. If a vouched identity is later caught as a duplicate, both bonds burn and the vouchers lose the right to vouch for 90 days. Planting a sybil grove of 1,000 fakes then needs 2,000 bonds, 20,000 POA at risk, and about 1,000 voucher-months, since every fake must echo off a real reputation. Honest newcomers rise like a lotus from mud: slowly, rooted in someone willing to pay if they're wrong.
